observations: Photo 0: a vertical stack of five used tyres on bare ground, tread worn, dust/mud on sidewalls, no legible size or brand markings.
Photo 1: same stack from a closer angle, yellow chalk marks on tread, still no readable DOT/size code, a white alloy wheel sits to the side on the ground.

Photo 2: four tyres laid flat side by side, each showing a different tread pattern, suggesting they are not an identical matched set; two or three separate alloy wheels are visible at the top edge of the frame, not mounted to any tyre.
No brand name, size (e.g. 2xx/4x R1x), or DOT date is legible on any tyre in any photo.
Watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the images; these are platform/seller marks, not proof of condition.

identity.kind: used tyre and alloy wheel set (quantity and matching unclear)

claims.claim: Direct Belgium tyres and wheels (implying imported used tyres from Belgium, often used in Nigeria to imply decent remaining tread)
claims.evidence: No import paperwork, country-of-origin sticker, or DOT code is visible in any photo; origin cannot be confirmed from images.
Wheels are visible in the background of photo 1 and photo 2 but are not clearly grouped with the tyres as a confirmed matching set for sale.

risks.risk: Tyre size (width/profile/rim diameter) unknown, which drives most of the price
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tyre sidewall showing the size code (e.g. 225/45R17) and DOT date
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, treated as unknown-size stock

risks.risk: Tread depth and wear are only visible from a distance; true remaining tread (mm) unclear
risks.proof: A close-up photo with a tread-depth gauge or coin against the grooves on each tyre

risks.risk: Set may be mismatched (photo 2 shows four distinct tread patterns), reducing usability as a matched axle set
risks.proof: A photo showing all four sidewalls with matching brand/size stamped together
risks.if_unproven: priced as a mismatched/odd set, not a uniform set

risks.risk: Sidewall integrity (cracks, bulges, repairs) cannot be confirmed from the angles shown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each full sidewall, inner and outer face
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly compromised, not fully roadworthy

risks.risk: Whether the alloy wheels shown are actually included in this listing or just background clutter from another lot
risks.proof: A photo of the wheels and tyres physically paired/mounted together, or seller's explicit confirmation with a wheel count matching the tyre count
risks.if_unproven: priced as tyres only, wheels excluded

proof_requests: Close-up of a tyre sidewall showing the size code and DOT/date code
Tread-depth measurement shot (coin or gauge) on each tyre
Confirmation photo showing wheels mounted with these specific tyres if wheels are part of the sale
Full sidewall shots (inner and outer) of each tyre for crack/repair check
response.reason: No tyre size or brand is legible in any photo, which is the primary driver of tyre pricing, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until a readable sidewall shot is provided.
